t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are different combinartions of colours and heights of gnomes. The game also seems to read your answers and may change the high scoring ones as it progresses.

vb_textbox.text: The pairs of gnomes always stay the same eg tall purple hat will always show up with the same partner eg short orange hat.  They may switch sides.  This means you can just take note of which colour seems to be getting the best results.  9 is the highest and 0 is the lowest.  Try and learn which of the two gives the best results.Over time, the computer may switch things up and make the better gnome start to decrease in points so be wary of this change.
